mission.objective: Schema change, its implementation, then the docs/migration note
mission.title: Add createdAt to the Session record
mission.task: Add a `createdAt` field to the Session record: first extend the schema, then update the store implementation to populate and read it, then write the migration note and update the docs describing the new field. Each step strictly needs the previous one finished first.

candidateNodes.title: Schema change
candidateNodes.task: Add createdAt to the Session schema in src/schema/session.ts.
acceptance: schema validates a Session with createdAt
existing Session records without it still parse (optional field)

candidateNodes.title: Store implementation
candidateNodes.task: Populate and read createdAt in src/store/sessionStore.ts.
acceptance: new sessions get a createdAt timestamp
reading an old session without createdAt does not throw

candidateNodes.title: Docs + migration note
candidateNodes.task: Write the migration note and update docs/SESSION-SCHEMA.md describing createdAt.
acceptance: docs describe the new field and its default
migration note explains the backfill behavior
